summary: Germany StGB § 222 (Fahrlässige Tötung): negligent homicide carries up to 5 years imprisonment or a fine.
label_raw: Fahrlässige Tötung (§ 222 StGB) – up to 5 years or fine
source_citation: StGB § 222 (gesetze-im-internet.de); summary: Murder in German law, Wikipedia. Up to 5 yr imprisonment or fine.

summary: Germany StGB § 211 (Mord): intentional killing with statutory aggravators (base motives, treachery, cruelty) carries mandatory life imprisonment, parole eligible after a 15-year minimum (longer where particular gravity of guilt is found).
source_citation: StGB § 211 (dejure.org/gesetze/StGB/211.html; gesetze-im-internet.de); summary: Murder in German law, Wikipedia. Premeditated/aggravated intentional killing; parole min 15 yr.

summary: Germany StGB § 212 (Totschlag): intentional homicide without § 211 aggravators carries 5 to 15 years; especially grave cases → life, lesser cases under § 213 → 1 to 10 years.
harm_duration: 5 to 15 years (life in especially grave cases)
source_citation: StGB § 212 (dejure.org/gesetze/StGB/212.html). Range 5-15 yr; § 213 lesser cases 1-10 yr; especially grave → life.

summary: France Code pénal Art. 221-3 (Assassinat): premeditated or ambush murder carries life imprisonment (réclusion criminelle à perpétuité).
source_citation: Légifrance, Code pénal Section 1 Art. 221-1 to 221-5-4 (LEGISCTA000006165276). Premeditated/ambush intentional killing → life.

summary: France Code pénal Art. 221-6 (Homicide involontaire): involuntary/negligent homicide carries up to 5 years plus a €75,000 fine, raised to 10 years plus €150,000 where committed with a deliberate breach of a safety obligation.
harm_duration: up to 5 years (10 years with deliberate breach)
label_raw: Homicide involontaire (Art. 221-6) – up to 5 yr + €75,000 (10 yr + €150,000 aggravated)
source_citation: Légifrance, Code pénal Art. 221-6 (LEGIARTI000006417578). Up to 5 yr + €75,000 fine; 10 yr + €150,000 with manquement délibéré. Fine in original EUR; not USD-normalized.

summary: France Code pénal Art. 221-1 (Meurtre): intentional killing carries 30 years' criminal imprisonment (réclusion criminelle).
source_citation: Légifrance, Code pénal Art. 221-1 (LEGIARTI000006417561). 30 yr réclusion criminelle.

summary: Japan Penal Code Art. 210 (death due to negligence): punishable by a fine of up to ¥1,000,000, with no imprisonment as the base penalty.
label_raw: Death due to negligence (Art. 210) – fine up to ¥1,000,000
source_citation: Japanese Law Translation, Penal Code Art. 210 (japaneselawtranslation.go.jp/en/laws/view/3581/en). Fine ≤ ¥1,000,000, no base imprisonment. Fine in original JPY; not USD-normalized.

summary: Japan Penal Code Art. 211 (negligence in pursuit of social activities / gross negligence causing death): punishable by imprisonment without work up to 5 years or a fine up to ¥2,500,000.
label_raw: Gross/occupational negligence causing death (Art. 211) – ≤ 5 yr or ¥2,500,000
source_citation: Japanese Law Translation, Penal Code Art. 211 (japaneselawtranslation.go.jp/en/laws/view/3581/en). Imprisonment without work ≤ 5 yr or fine ≤ ¥2,500,000. Fine in original JPY; not USD-normalized.

summary: Japan Penal Code Art. 199 (Satsujin): homicide/murder is punishable by death, life imprisonment with labour, or a definite term of not less than 5 years (up to the 20/30-year statutory cap).
harm_duration: death, life, or 5 years to statutory cap (20/30 years)
source_citation: Japanese Law Translation, Penal Code Art. 199 (japaneselawtranslation.go.jp/en/laws/view/3581/en). Act No. 45 of 1907, current translation. Death / life with labour / ≥ 5 yr.

summary: Netherlands Wetboek van Strafrecht Art. 307 (Dood door schuld): death by negligence carries up to 2 years for ordinary negligence and up to 4 years for reckless/gross negligence (roekeloosheid).
harm_duration: up to 2 years (up to 4 years if reckless/gross)
label_raw: Dood door schuld (Art. 307 WvSr) – up to 2 yr (4 yr gross)
source_citation: Dutch Penal Code Art. 307; summary: Murder (Dutch law), Wikipedia. Ordinary negligence ≤ 2 yr; reckless/gross negligence ≤ 4 yr.

summary: Netherlands Wetboek van Strafrecht Art. 287 (Doodslag): intentional killing without premeditation (manslaughter) carries up to 25 years or a fifth-category fine.
source_citation: Dutch Penal Code Art. 287; summary: Murder (Dutch law), Wikipedia. Up to 25 yr or 5th-category fine.

summary: Netherlands Wetboek van Strafrecht Art. 289 (Moord): premeditated killing (murder) carries life imprisonment or a determinate term up to 30 years.
label_raw: Moord (Art. 289 WvSr) – life or up to 30 years
source_citation: Dutch Penal Code Art. 289; summary: Murder (Dutch law), Wikipedia. Premeditated intentional killing; life or determinate ≤ 30 yr.

summary: Sweden Brottsbalken Ch. 3 § 2 (Dråp): less-serious intentional killing (manslaughter) carries 6 to 10 years.
source_citation: Brottsbalken Ch. 3 § 2; summary: Murder in Swedish law, Wikipedia. 6-10 yr.

summary: Sweden Brottsbalken Ch. 3 § 1 (Mord): intentional killing (murder) carries a fixed term of 10 to 18 years or life.
label_raw: Mord (Brottsbalken Ch.3 §1) – 10 to 18 years or life
source_citation: Brottsbalken Ch. 3 § 1; summary: Murder in Swedish law, Wikipedia. Fixed 10-18 yr or life.

summary: Sweden Brottsbalken Ch. 3 § 3 (Vållande till annans död): negligent homicide carries day-fines (petty cases) up to 2 years imprisonment, with the gross (grovt) variant 1 to 6 years.
harm_duration: up to 2 years (1 to 6 years if gross)
label_raw: Vållande till annans död (Brottsbalken Ch.3 §3) – day-fines to 2 yr (gross 1-6 yr)
source_citation: Brottsbalken Ch. 3 § 3; summary: Murder in Swedish law, Wikipedia. Base: day-fines to ≤ 2 yr; grovt 1-6 yr.
